notes: The posted results in doc_registry_NCT01394952.json were searched in outcomeMeasuresModule (all measures) and adverseEventsModule (seriousEvents and otherEvents terms, Gastrointestinal disorders entries, and eventGroups all-cause death/serious/other totals). They do not report the aggregate outcome of participants with any gastrointestinal adverse event. Individual gastrointestinal terms are narrower outcomes and were not summed. Counts and arm ownership therefore come from the held publication abstract; denominators are its explicitly printed randomized arm totals. All four counts agree with served.
